judgments.reason: The model never articulates the mechanism that the three-coin commission is included before payment or how bids above coins can win; its outputs only repeat waiting behavior and do not explain rule ordering or payment/commission ordering.

Although the player repeatedly says to 'wait to see P3's bid', the model does not articulate the mechanism by which waiting reveals committed sealed rival bids before committing; it does not state that waiting causes revelation or explain the turn-order/information rule.
The model never states that 'close' settles the game even with unauctioned lots or explains terminal-resolution behavior; it only issues wait actions and gives no mechanism for settlement timing.

The model does not claim or explain that catalog purchases receive the three-coin commission or otherwise substitute objectives; its articulation contains only repeated waits and no mechanism linking catalog buys to auction commissions.
